parameters.description: First simulated year (January).
Real-world baseline year used to initialise national totals and for country comparison.
parameters.source: Most recent year with broadly complete World Bank WDI coverage at time of data retrieval

parameters.description: Initial national development fund available to the planner.
parameters.source: User-configurable starting condition (not a real-world figure)

parameters.description: Fixed exchange rate for converting simulated GDP to US$.
parameters.source: Approximately the 2023 average RBI reference rate (≈82.6); held constant — no exchange-rate model

parameters.description: Output per worker in the pre-existing informal/agrarian economy that the greenfield scenario starts with (₹1.5 lakh).
parameters.source: Order of magnitude of agricultural GVA per agricultural worker in India; greenfield simplification

parameters.description: Exogenous productivity growth of the legacy economy.
Productivity uplift of legacy workers in districts with full grid electricity.
parameters.source: Indicative; electrification raises household enterprise productivity

parameters.description: Productivity uplift of legacy workers in districts with full transport access.
parameters.source: Indicative; rural road access literature finds positive but varied effects

parameters.description: Share of legacy output that is agriculture.
parameters.source: Based on census 2011 cultivators + agricultural labourers ≈ 55% of workers

parameters.description: Induced services value added per unit of formal facility value added (trade, transport, finance, etc.).
Share of construction spending that is domestic value added.
Private capital available per year for privately financed construction.
parameters.source: India gross savings ≈30% of GDP (RBI); greenfield discount applied

parameters.description: Share of surplus goods production that can be exported.
Growth of employment capacity in the legacy economy.
General government tax revenue as share of GDP before policy changes.
parameters.source: Combined Centre + States tax-to-GDP in India ≈17-18% (RBI State Finances / Union Budget documents)

parameters.description: Interest rate on government debt.
Additional interest when debt exceeds 80% of GDP.
Share of people aged 65+ receiving a public pension.
parameters.source: Indicative; NSAP + civil-service pensions cover a minority of elderly

parameters.description: Average public pension per covered person (₹12,000/yr).
parameters.source: Indicative blend of NSAP (~₹200-500/month) and formal pensions

parameters.description: Total fertility rate at start (overridden by World Bank value when available).
Life expectancy at start (overridden by World Bank value when available).
Sex ratio at birth.
parameters.source: India SRS ≈1.07-1.11 (Office of the Registrar General)

parameters.description: Maximum share of population that migrates between districts per year in response to opportunity.
parameters.source: Indicative; Census 2011 inter-district migration flows are of this order

parameters.description: Life-expectancy gain when health-service index reaches 1 (relative to start).
Life expectancy lost per µg/m3 of PM2.5.
parameters.source: AQLI (EPIC, Univ. of Chicago): ≈0.98 years per 10 µg/m3 sustained exposure

parameters.description: Life-expectancy gain from full safe water & sanitation coverage relative to start.
Life expectancy response to income growth.
Proportional TFR reduction per +1.0 change in urban share.
parameters.source: Indicative; urban TFR lower than rural (NFHS-5: 1.6 vs 2.1)

parameters.description: Proportional TFR reduction per +1.0 change in education index.
parameters.source: Indicative; strong association of female schooling with fertility (NFHS-5)

parameters.description: Labour force as share of population aged 15-64 (overridden by World Bank data).
Unemployment rate at start (overridden by World Bank data).
Fallback household size.
parameters.source: Census of India 2011 (1.21 bn / 249 m households ≈4.87)

parameters.description: Share of census 2011 graduates assumed to be practising engineers.
parameters.source: Indicative; AISHE shows engineering ~12-15% of enrolment

parameters.description: Share of people with secondary/higher-secondary education counted as skilled technicians.
Researchers per million population at start.
Physicians per 1,000 people at start (medical workforce stock).
Share of labour force available for unskilled/semi-skilled formal jobs.
Retirement / exit rate of the skilled workforce.
Share of other states' surplus skilled workers who will relocate for jobs.
Emigration rate of surplus engineers & scientists without suitable jobs.
Residential electricity demand per person when connected.
parameters.source: India residential ≈25% of ~1,300 kWh per-capita consumption (CEA General Review 2023)

parameters.description: Commercial & public demand per urban resident.
Pumping demand per irrigated hectare.
Transmission losses on the modelled grid.
parameters.source: CEA reports AT&C losses ≈15-20% overall; transmission-only losses lower

parameters.description: Reliability penalty per unit of variable-renewable share above 30% not covered by storage.
Hours of storage that firm 1 MW of variable output.
Urban domestic water demand norm.
parameters.source: CPHEEO Manual on Water Supply (1999), towns with sewerage

parameters.description: Rural domestic water norm.
parameters.source: Jal Jeevan Mission service norm (55 lpcd)

parameters.description: Share of supplied water returned as sewage.
parameters.source: CPHEEO Manual on Sewerage (80% return flow)

parameters.description: Share of industrial water need met by groundwater self-supply where no treatment plant serves the district and no river/coast intake is possible.
Urban municipal solid waste generation.
parameters.source: CPCB annual reports indicate roughly 0.3-0.6 kg/capita/day

parameters.description: Rural solid waste generation.
Benchmark hospital beds used for the health index.
Population per Primary Health Centre (plains).
parameters.source: Indian Public Health Standards (IPHS) norms, MoHFW

parameters.description: Share of population aged 6-17 (initial; then derived from age structure).
Share of school-age children covered by pre-existing schools in the greenfield scenario.
Food-grain equivalent requirement per person.
parameters.source: Indicative: ICMR-NIN recommended cereal + pulse intake ≈ 150-200 kg/yr

parameters.description: Share of food need met by legacy rain-fed farming at start.
Yield uplift on legacy farmland per irrigated hectare share.
parameters.source: Irrigated yields typically 50-100% higher than rain-fed in India

parameters.description: Maximum distance from a road for a facility to count as road-connected.
Maximum distance to a connected rail node (station / terminal / dry port).
Maximum distance to a port for direct access without network connection.
Maximum distance to an airport for air access.
Maximum distance to fibre backbone for connectivity.
Lines whose vertices are within this distance are connected.
A bridge within this distance of a river crossing completes the crossing.
Power facilities within this distance of a transmission line are connected to it.
Water facilities within this distance of a pipeline are connected to it.
Output factor when the facility's technology requirement is one level short.
Output factor when two or more levels short.
Output factor per missing supporting-industry requirement.
Background research points generated by the national research workforce (per domain share).
Residential PM2.5 emissions per capita (biomass cooking/heating) without clean energy.
parameters.source: Order of magnitude from Indian inventories (e.g. GAINS-India, EDGAR); not calibrated

parameters.description: Residential + legacy transport NOx per capita.
Residential SO2 per capita.
Residential CO per capita.
Residential VOC per capita.
Non-biogenic household + legacy CO2 per capita.
Reduction of residential emissions when a district is fully electrified.
Crop-residue burning PM2.5 per rural person in residue-burning states (Oct-Nov).
Natural/regional background PM2.5.
Natural background PM10 (dust).
Additional PM10 over the Thar desert region.
Fraction of SO2 lost by chemistry that forms PM2.5 mass (as sulfate).
parameters.source: Indicative; sulfate/SO2 mass ratio 1.5 x conversion fraction

parameters.description: Fraction of NOx lost by chemistry that forms PM2.5 mass (as nitrate).
Population density at which road traffic emission factors apply at 1x.

parameters.unit: km of modelled road per km²
parameters.description: Density of modelled (major) roads at which a district counts as fully accessible.
parameters.source: Model scale; modelled roads are trunk roads only

parameters.description: Share of capex paid by government for privately owned facility types before industrial policies.
Resolution of the air-quality grid.
Share of the pre-existing housing stock lost each year to deterioration.
parameters.source: Indicative; census 2011 recorded ~5% of houses as dilapidated

parameters.description: Net sown area as share of geographic area (used for irrigation coverage).
parameters.source: India net sown area ≈140 Mha of 329 Mha (Land Use Statistics, MoA&FW)

parameters.description: GDP per capita at which the income component of the development score reaches 100.
Recurring non-development government spending (administration, defence, law & order, transfers) that exists regardless of the planner's choices.
parameters.source: Indian general government expenditure is ≈28% of GDP (RBI); this greenfield model separates out development capex/opex modelled explicitly

parameters.description: Facilities within this distance of a major river or the coast can build their own raw-water intake.
parameters.source: Indicative; thermal plants typically draw from nearby rivers/reservoirs or use sea water

parameters.description: Share of water need met by a facility's own river/sea intake when no treated supply serves it.
parameters.source: Indicative; allows for seasonal low flows

parameters.description: All 'assumption' parameters are indicative modelling choices, not measured facts. Ranges are used for uncertainty projections.
